definitions.gloss: to replace, to exchange, to swap
definitions.explanation: To remove one thing and put another in its place, or to exchange two things with each other. Used for replacing worn-out items, swapping objects, and exchanging goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{換|か}える。
⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced the worn-out tires with new ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{換|か}えるようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make it a point to swap out the curtains in my room each season.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as ⟦{取|と}り{替|か}える→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧. Both kanji spellings (⟦{換|か}える→換える：13346_kaeru⟧ and ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧) are used, with {換|か} emphasizing technical replacement and {替|か} emphasizing general swapping. In practice they are often interchangeable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace a light bulb
- ⟦フィルター→フィルター：21847_firutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace a filter
- ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace a part
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace with a new one

SIMILAR WORDS:
{取|と}り{換|か}える focuses on removing one item and inserting another. ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is more formal and often implies a mutual exchange. ⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧ emphasizes putting something new in place of the old.
